what_happened: Style/layout 2 (microwave built in above a wall oven, same model as success s3; keypad right of the door, START/ENTER and STOP/CLEAR in the bottom block). Stage 0: squash grasped at 123, released into the black bowl at 251 (stage 0 at 251). Stage 1: bowl grasped at 339 (the squash touches the fingers during the carry; packet 'holds' 341-360 and 455-593 for the vegetable are these contacts), released inside at 596, stage 1 at 610 (359 steps). Stage 2: door shut 698-751 (141 steps, fast). Stage 3 had 649 steps. 760-892: the gripper went straight to the bottom block of the keypad; contacts 828-839, 873-877 and 888-892 landed on the KITCHEN TIMER / TIME COOK keys with START/ENTER immediately to the right of the fingertips (about one key width, 2-3 cm). It then moved up the panel (contact 1025-1029 near the top edge) and onto the number keys (1138-1143), and from ~1200 to ~1360 wandered right and up, the wrist looking at the kitchen counter and cabinets, coming back toward the keypad only at 1380-1400.
causal_chain: door closed 751 with 649 steps left -> three presses 828-892 one key left of START (Kitchen Timer) -> no correction onto START -> more presses at the wrong places 1025, 1138 -> wander 1200-1360 -> timeout
self_recovery: re-pressed three times at almost the same spot (828-892), then tried other spots on the panel (1025, 1138); none hit START.
official_criterion_notes: The vegetable 'holds' 341-360 (height drop -0.314) and 455-593 are the squash in the bowl touching the fingers while the bowl is carried, not grasps of the squash.
uncertain_about: Key identities are read from the rotated wrist view; the offset is about one key.
